description: Evaluation prompts on a real map: Sophia Antipolis / Biot, France (Open Location Code 8FM9J389+G7, centre 43.61625 N, 7.06813 E; bbox S 43.61225 W 7.06263 N 43.62025 E 7.07363, 0.79 km2; OSM cached in eval/maps/sophia_antipolis.osm). Same fields as prompts.json. Every requested object type exists on this map (14 bus stops, 14 benches, 3 waste baskets, 65 trees, 41 crossings of which 12 zebra and 2 signalised).

prompts.text: Walk along the sidewalk to the nearest bus stop.
The participant should find the bench nearby and walk up to it.
Go to the waste basket and stop next to it.
Walk out onto the road and stand on the marked spot just past a crossing.
The participant must stand in the middle of the carriageway for a moment.
Have the user walk onto the road surface at the far end of the street.
Cross the road but stay inside the marked corridor along the crosswalk.
Follow the marked path along the street without leaving it.
Walk to the crossing using only the sidewalk; stepping off it means failure.
Cross the road at the zebra crossing without touching the parked cars.
Walk between the parked cars along the kerb and reach the other end without touching any of them.
Avoid the parked vehicles along the street while you walk to the bus stop.
Cross at the zebra crossing while a car approaches; avoid being hit.
A bus drives along the street. Walk across the road without being hit by it.
Cross the road with oncoming traffic and keep clear of the speeding car.
First walk to the crossing, then cross the road, then continue to the spot on the other side.
Do three things in order: go to the bus stop, then to the bench, then to the waste basket.
Walk to the kerb, afterwards cross the road, and finally walk to the waste basket.
Visit the waste basket and the bench, in any order.
Find both the bench and the bus stop; the order does not matter.
Reach a bench and a tree, either one first.
Wait for the pedestrian light to turn green, then cross the road.
Cross at the signalised crossing on green while a car comes down the street, and stay clear of the car.
Look at the approaching car, then cross the road once it has passed.
At the crossing wait until the light is green, look at the traffic light, and then cross.
